input_metering_review.reviewer: Codex — official public documentation review; account contract/access unverified
input_metering_review.explanation: The documented context window includes the complete single-request input/output/reasoning. Full-context input reservation is conservative for accepted requests; body bytes are not used as a token estimate. Assumes current documented model limits apply.

tier_coverage_review.reviewer: Codex — official public documentation review; account contract/access unverified
tier_coverage_review.explanation: Unpinned service tier can inherit project Fast settings. Takes the greatest published Luna Standard/Fast short/long input or cache-write rate plus 10% uplift. No account-specific contract or alias immutability assertion.

output_metering_review.reviewer: Codex — official public documentation review; account contract/access unverified
output_metering_review.explanation: Frozen max_output_tokens=8000 bounds generated visible, reasoning and formatting tokens. Greatest published Luna output rate plus 10% uplift; reasoning is not charged twice.

other_cost_review.reviewer: Codex — official public documentation review; account contract/access unverified
other_cost_review.explanation: Token-usage reservation only for exact text Responses requests with no tools, retries, follow-ups or counting calls. No other per-request token component identified in cited public pricing. Taxes, account-specific contracts, shared-account usage and temporary Supabase charges are excluded and unverified; not a final-bill hard cap.

pricing_review.reviewer: Codex — official public documentation review; account contract/access unverified
pricing_review.explanation: Official public documentation sources and rates reviewed in provider-pricing-evidence.md on 2026-10-18. Assumes current PAYG rates/model limits remain applicable through the run; no authenticated account/pricing/access check performed.
